```{r}
# Figures 5A and 5B
# Note that Breastfed = Exclusive BF; Partially_breastfed = Mixed feeding; No_breastfed = Formula feeding in panels A and B
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Keep only positive CPM values for taxonomic abundance analyses
df <- df %>%
  filter(CPM > 0)


# PHAGE HOST FAMILY ABUNDANCE BY FEEDING GROUP ------------------------------------------

# Extract host family from the taxonomic annotation
df_family <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Host.family = str_extract(Host.genus, "(?<=f__)[^;]+")
  )

# Rename feeding categories to avoid spaces in column names
df_family <- df_family %>%
  mutate(
    feeding_cat = case_when(
      feeding_cat == "Partially breastfed" ~ "Partially_breastfed",
      feeding_cat == "No breastfed" ~ "No_breastfed",
      TRUE ~ feeding_cat
    )
  )

# Calculate mean CPM per feeding group
df_heatmap <- df_family %>%
  group_by(
    Host.family,
    timepoint_months,
    mother_infant,
    feeding_cat,
    bodysite
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE) / n_distinct(Sample),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert feeding groups to wide format
df_heatmap_wide <- df_heatmap %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = feeding_cat,
    values_from = mean_CPM
  )

# Create timepoint labels
df_heatmap_wide <- df_heatmap_wide %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Week Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Month Infant",
      timepoint_months == 6 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 12 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1 & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "1 Month Mother",
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "1 Month Mother"
    )
  )

# Set timepoint order
df_heatmap_wide$timepoint_label <- factor(
  df_heatmap_wide$timepoint_label,
  levels = c(
    "1 Week Infant",
    "1 Month Infant",
    "6 Months Infant",
    "12 Months Infant",
    "1 Month Mother"
  )
)

# Identify host families present in infants
families_in_infants <- df_heatmap_wide %>%
  filter(str_detect(timepoint_label, "Infant")) %>%
  pull(Host.family) %>%
  unique()

# Keep infant-associated families and the corresponding maternal samples
df_heatmap_wide_filtered <- df_heatmap_wide %>%
  filter(Host.family %in% families_in_infants) %>%
  filter(
    !(mother_infant == "mother" & timepoint_label != "1 Month Mother")
  )

# Order host families by total CPM abundance
family_order <- df_heatmap_wide_filtered %>%
  group_by(Host.family) %>%
  summarise(
    total_CPM = sum(
      Breastfeeding,
      Partially_breastfed,
      No_breastfed,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_CPM)) %>%
  pull(Host.family)

df_heatmap_wide_filtered$Host.family <- factor(
  df_heatmap_wide_filtered$Host.family,
  levels = family_order
)

# Generate the CPM abundance heatmap
heatmap_plot_CPM <- ggplot(
  df_heatmap_wide_filtered,
  aes(
    x = timepoint_label,
    y = Host.family
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = Breastfeeding),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.3)
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = Partially_breastfed),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = No_breastfed),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "cornflowerblue",
    high = "red",
    name = "Mean CPM"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time point",
    y = "Phage host family"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

print(heatmap_plot_CPM)


# vOTU RICHNESS BY FEEDING GROUP AND PHAGE HOST FAMILY -----------------------------------------

# Reload the original data
df_richness <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Extract host family
df_richness <- df_richness %>%
  mutate(
    Host.family = str_extract(Host.genus, "(?<=f__)[^;]+")
  )

# Rename feeding categories
df_richness <- df_richness %>%
  mutate(
    feeding_cat = case_when(
      feeding_cat == "Partially breastfed" ~ "Partially_breastfed",
      feeding_cat == "No breastfed" ~ "No_breastfed",
      TRUE ~ feeding_cat
    )
  )

# Calculate the number of unique vOTUs per sample
df_sample_richness <- df_richness %>%
  filter(CPM > 0) %>%
  group_by(
    Sample,
    Host.family,
    timepoint_months,
    mother_infant,
    feeding_cat,
    bodysite
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_vOTUs = n_distinct(vOTUs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate mean richness per feeding group
df_group_richness <- df_sample_richness %>%
  group_by(
    Host.family,
    timepoint_months,
    mother_infant,
    feeding_cat,
    bodysite
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_richness = mean(n_vOTUs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create timepoint labels
df_group_richness <- df_group_richness %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Week Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Month Infant",
      timepoint_months == 6 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 12 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1 & mother_infant == "mother" ~ "1 Month Mother"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label))

# Identify host families present in infants
families_in_infants <- df_group_richness %>%
  filter(str_detect(timepoint_label, "Infant")) %>%
  pull(Host.family) %>%
  unique()

# Keep infant-associated host families
df_plot <- df_group_richness %>%
  filter(Host.family %in% families_in_infants) %>%
  filter(
    !(mother_infant == "mother" & timepoint_label != "1 Month Mother")
  )

# Set timepoint order
df_plot$timepoint_label <- factor(
  df_plot$timepoint_label,
  levels = c(
    "1 Week Infant",
    "1 Month Infant",
    "6 Months Infant",
    "12 Months Infant",
    "1 Month Mother"
  )
)

# Order host families by total richness
family_order <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Host.family) %>%
  summarise(
    total = sum(mean_richness),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  pull(Host.family)

df_plot$Host.family <- factor(
  df_plot$Host.family,
  levels = family_order
)

# Convert richness data to wide format
df_wide <- df_plot %>%
  select(
    timepoint_label,
    Host.family,
    feeding_cat,
    mean_richness
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    timepoint_label,
    Host.family,
    feeding_cat
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_richness = mean(mean_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = feeding_cat,
    values_from = mean_richness
  )

# Generate the vOTU richness heatmap
heatmap <- ggplot(
  df_wide,
  aes(
    x = timepoint_label,
    y = Host.family
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = Breastfeeding),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.3)
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = Partially_breastfed),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    aes(fill = No_breastfed),
    color = "white",
    width = 0.3,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.3)
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "cornflowerblue",
      "lightpink",
      "red"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(
      c(
        10,
        25,
        50
      )
    ),
    breaks = c(
      10,
      25,
      50
    ),
    limits = c(
      0,
      60
    ),
    name = "Mean vOTUs",
    na.value = "gray"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Phage host family"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

print(heatmap)
```

```{r}
# FIGURE 5C
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(clubSandwich)

# INPUT + PREPARATION -----------------------------------------------------

df <- read_csv(here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

to_months <- function(x){
  x <- str_trim(str_replace_all(as.character(x), ",", "."))
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  days <- str_match(tolower(x), "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*days?$")[,2]
  out[!is.na(days) & is.na(out)] <- as.numeric(days[!is.na(days)]) / 30.4

  rng <- str_match(tolower(x),
                   "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*-\\s*(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*days?$")[,2:3]
  if (!all(is.na(rng))) {
    mid <- rowMeans(suppressWarnings(apply(rng, 2, as.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)
    out[!is.na(mid) & is.na(out)] <- mid[!is.na(mid)] / 30.4
  }

  mon <- str_match(tolower(x), "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*m(?:onths?)?$")[,2]
  out[!is.na(mon) & is.na(out)] <- as.numeric(mon[!is.na(mon)])
  out
}

df_i <- df %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_months = to_months(timepoint_months),
    bf_months = to_months(breastfeeding_duration),
    bodysite = tolower(as.character(bodysite)),
    mother_infant = tolower(as.character(mother_infant)),

    # IMPORTANTE: conservar SOLO lo que hay después de g__
    Host.genus = str_trim(sub(".*g__", "", as.character(Host.genus))),

    milk_tp = if_else(
      !is.na(bf_months) & !is.na(timepoint_months),
      bf_months >= timepoint_months,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite %in% c("stool", "faeces", "feces"),
    !is.na(Host.genus), Host.genus != "",
    !is.na(milk_tp)
  )

df6  <- df_i %>% filter(timepoint_months == 6)
df12 <- df_i %>% filter(timepoint_months == 12)


# prevalence filter + LMM, OLS-CR2 fallback -------------------------------

fit_host_milk <- function(dflong, min_subjects = 3){

  host_long <- dflong %>%
    group_by(Sample, subject, Host.genus, milk_tp) %>%
    summarise(CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # IMPORTANTE:
  # elimina géneros presentes en menos de 3 individuos.
  # Así Cronobacter no entra si solo aparece en 1-2 individuos.
  keep <- host_long %>%
    group_by(Host.genus) %>%
    summarise(
      prev = mean(CPM > 0),
      nsub = n_distinct(subject[CPM > 0]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(nsub >= min_subjects) %>%
    arrange(desc(prev)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%
    pull(Host.genus)

  host_long <- host_long %>% filter(Host.genus %in% keep)

  wide <- host_long %>%
    select(Sample, Host.genus, CPM) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Host.genus, values_from = CPM, values_fill = 0)

  mat <- as.matrix(wide[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- wide$Sample

  prop <- sweep(mat, 1, rowSums(mat) + 1e-12, "/")
  prop[prop == 0] <- 1e-6
  clr <- sweep(log(prop), 1, rowMeans(log(prop)), "-")

  meta <- host_long %>% distinct(Sample, subject, milk_tp)

  dfc <- as.data.frame(clr) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "Sample")

  fit_one <- function(col){

    ff <- reformulate("milk_tp", response = paste0("`", col, "`"))

    out <- try({
      m <- lmer(
        update(ff, . ~ . + (1 | subject)),
        data = dfc,
        control = lmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
        )
      )

      if (isSingular(m, 1e-4)) stop("singular")

      broom.mixed::tidy(m, effects = "fixed") %>%
        filter(term == "milk_tpTRUE") %>%
        transmute(
          taxon = col,
          estimate,
          std.error,
          p.value,
          model = "LMM"
        )
    }, silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(out, "try-error")) {

      lmfit <- lm(ff, data = dfc)
      vc <- clubSandwich::vcovCR(
        lmfit,
        cluster = dfc$subject,
        type = "CR2"
      )
      co <- clubSandwich::coef_test(lmfit, vcov = vc)

      target <- rownames(co)[grepl("^milk_tp", rownames(co))][1]

      tibble(
        taxon = col,
        estimate = co[target, "beta"],
        std.error = co[target, "SE"],
        p.value = co[target, "p_Satt"],
        model = "OLS-CR2"
      )

    } else out
  }

  map_dfr(colnames(clr), fit_one) %>%
    mutate(
      q = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      lo = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      hi = estimate + 1.96 * std.error,
      sig_cat = case_when(
        q < 0.05 ~ "< 0.05",
        q < 0.10 ~ "< 0.10",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      ),
      dir = if_else(estimate > 0, "Human milk↑", "Weaned↑"),
      label = taxon
    ) %>%
    arrange(q)
}


# MODELS ---------------------------------------------------------------

res6  <- fit_host_milk(df6,  min_subjects = 12)
res12 <- fit_host_milk(df12, min_subjects = 12)


# Top-10 according to 12-month FDR
top10 <- res12 %>%
  arrange(q) %>%
  distinct(label, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(label)

cat("\nTOP 10 GENERA:\n")
print(top10)

res12_p <- res12 %>% filter(label %in% top10)
res6_p  <- res6  %>% filter(label %in% top10)

ord <- res12_p %>% arrange(estimate) %>% pull(label) %>% unique()

both <- bind_rows(
  res6_p  %>% mutate(tp = "6 m"),
  res12_p %>% mutate(tp = "12 m")
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = factor(label, levels = ord),
    tp = factor(tp, levels = c("6 m", "12 m")),
    sig_cat = factor(sig_cat, levels = c("< 0.05", "< 0.10", "ns")),
    dir = factor(dir, levels = c("Human milk↑", "Weaned↑"))
  )

lim <- max(abs(c(both$lo, both$hi)), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

sig_colors <- c(
  "< 0.05" = "purple4",
  "< 0.10" = "#B09DDD",
  "ns" = "grey75"
)

p_forest <- ggplot(
  both %>% filter(!is.na(estimate)),
  aes(x = estimate, y = label)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      xmin = lo,
      xmax = hi,
      color = sig_cat,
      shape = dir,
      linetype = model
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1,
    fatten = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "FDR", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Human milk↑" = 16, "Weaned↑" = 2),
    name = "",
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("LMM" = "solid", "OLS-CR2" = "dotdash"),
    name = "Model"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-lim, lim)) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~tp,
    ncol = 2,
    labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste0("Human milk effect at ", x))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Human milk (TRUE) effect (CLR units)",
    y = "Host genus",
    title = "Human milk effect on host-associated genera at 6 and 12 months"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_forest
```

```{r}
# FIGURE 5D
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(grid)

df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

to_months <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x) |> str_trim()
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(x, ",", ".")))

  days <- str_match(
    x,
    "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*days?$"
  )[,2]

  out[!is.na(days)] <-
    as.numeric(days[!is.na(days)]) / 30.4

  rng <- str_match(
    x,
    "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*-\\s*(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*days?$"
  )[,2:3]

  if (!all(is.na(rng))) {
    rng_num <- suppressWarnings(apply(rng, 2, as.numeric))
    mid <- rowMeans(rng_num, na.rm = TRUE)
    out[!is.na(mid)] <- mid[!is.na(mid)] / 30.4
  }

  mon <- str_match(
    x,
    "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)(?:\\s*)m(?:onths)?$"
  )[,2]

  out[!is.na(mon) & is.na(out)] <-
    as.numeric(mon[!is.na(mon)])

  mon2 <- str_match(
    x,
    "^(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)\\s*months?$"
  )[,2]

  out[!is.na(mon2) & is.na(out)] <-
    as.numeric(mon2[!is.na(mon2)])

  out
}

df_i <- df %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_months =
      suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(
          str_replace(
            as.character(timepoint_months),
            ",",
            "."
          )
        )
      ),

    bf_months =
      to_months(breastfeeding_duration),

    milk_tp =
      case_when(
        !is.na(bf_months) &
          !is.na(timepoint_months) ~
          bf_months >= timepoint_months,

        TRUE ~ NA
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    tolower(mother_infant) == "infant",
    tolower(bodysite) %in% c("stool", "feces", "faeces")
  )

df6 <- df_i %>%
  filter(timepoint_months == 6)

df12 <- df_i %>%
  filter(timepoint_months == 12)

alpha_tp <- function(dflong){

  dflong %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    summarise(
      shannon =
        diversity(
          CPM,
          "shannon"
        ),

      milk_tp =
        first(milk_tp),

      .groups =
        "drop"
    ) %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(milk_tp),
      !is.na(shannon)
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      milk_tp =
        factor(
          ifelse(
            milk_tp,
            "Yes",
            "No"
          ),
          levels = c(
            "Yes",
            "No"
          )
        )
    )
}

# 6 and 12 months
a6 <- alpha_tp(df6) %>%
  mutate(tp = "6 months")

a12 <- alpha_tp(df12) %>%
  mutate(tp = "12 months")

alpha_all <- bind_rows(
  a6,
  a12
) %>%
  mutate(
    tp =
      factor(
        tp,
        levels = c(
          "6 months",
          "12 months"
        )
      )
  )

wilcox_by_tp <- alpha_all %>%
  group_by(tp) %>%
  summarise(
    n_yes =
      sum(milk_tp == "Yes"),

    n_no =
      sum(milk_tp == "No"),

    p =
      ifelse(
        n_yes >= 2 & n_no >= 2,

        wilcox.test(
          shannon ~ milk_tp,
          data = cur_data_all(),
          exact = FALSE,
          correct = FALSE
        )$p.value,

        NA_real_
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    p_BH =
      p.adjust(
        p,
        method = "BH"
      ),

    label =
      ifelse(
        is.na(p_BH),
        "Insufficient data",
        paste0(
          "Wilcoxon p(BH) = ",
          format.pval(
            p_BH,
            digits = 3
          )
        )
      )
  )

n_tab <- alpha_all %>%
  count(
    tp,
    milk_tp,
    name = "n"
  )

ylims <- c(
  1.5,
  5.5
)

p_alpha <- ggplot(
  alpha_all,
  aes(
    x = milk_tp,
    y = shannon,
    fill = milk_tp
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.72,
    outlier.alpha = 0.35,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.06,
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = n_tab,
    aes(
      x = milk_tp,
      y = ylims[2] - 0.08,
      label = paste0(
        "n=",
        n
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ tp,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "fixed"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Yes" = "purple4",
      "No" = "#EDE7FA"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0.05,
        0.05
      )
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = ylims,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Human milk at sampling (Yes/No)",
    y = "Shannon diversity"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid.minor =
      element_blank(),

    legend.position =
      "none",

    strip.text =
      element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),

    axis.title.x =
      element_text(
        margin = margin(t = 6)
      ),

    axis.title.y =
      element_text(
        margin = margin(r = 6)
      ),

    panel.spacing.x =
      unit(
        50,
        "pt"
      )
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = wilcox_by_tp,
    aes(
      x = 1.05,
      y = ylims[2] - 0.45,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.2,
```

```{r}
# FIGURE 5E

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(vegan)
  library(ape)
  library(patchwork)
})

# Load data ----------------------------------------------------------------

df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "results_with_metadata2.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Clean Diet + metadata ---------------------------------------------------

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    bodysite = tolower(bodysite),
    mother_infant = tolower(mother_infant),
    Diet = tolower(trimws(as.character(Diet))),
    Diet = str_replace_all(Diet, "\\s+", "_"),
    Diet = case_when(
      Diet %in% c("breastfeeding","breasfteeding","breast_feeding","breast-fed","breastfed") ~ "breastfeeding",
      Diet %in% c("formula","infant_formula","milk_formula") ~ "formula",
      Diet %in% c("mixed","mixed_feeding","mixed_diet") ~ "mixed",
      Diet %in% c("solid_foods","solid","solids","complementary_feeding") ~ "solid_foods",
      TRUE ~ Diet
    ),
    timepoint_months = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(timepoint_months)))
  )

# Keep infants + stool only ----------------------------------------------

df_i <- df %>%
  filter(
    mother_infant == "infant",
    bodysite == "stool",
    !is.na(timepoint_months),
    !is.na(Diet),
    Diet != ""
  )

# Diet levels + colours --------------------------------------------------

diet_levels <- c("breastfeeding", "mixed", "formula", "solid_foods")

diet_colors <- c(
  "breastfeeding" = "purple4",
  "mixed"         = "gold",
  "formula"       = "mediumaquamarine",
  "solid_foods"   = "steelblue3"
)

df_i <- df_i %>%
  mutate(Diet = factor(Diet, levels = diet_levels))


# Pretty labels for timepoints -------------------------------------------

tp_title <- function(tp){
  dplyr::case_when(
    tp == 0.25 ~ "1 week",
    tp == 1    ~ "1 month",
    tp == 6    ~ "6 months",
    tp == 12   ~ "12 months",
    TRUE       ~ paste0(tp, " months")
  )
}

# Global text sizes -----------------------------------------------------

BASE_SIZE   <- 20
TITLE_SIZE  <- 24
AXIS_T_SIZE <- 22
AXIS_TXT    <- 20
LEG_T_SIZE  <- 22
LEG_TXT     <- 20

# Function: PCoA per timepoint -----------------------------------------

pcoa_by_tp <- function(d, tp){

  d_tp <- d %>%
    filter(timepoint_months == tp) %>%
    select(Sample, vOTUs, CPM, Diet) %>%
    mutate(CPM = as.numeric(CPM)) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Diet, vOTUs) %>%
    summarise(CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  wide <- d_tp %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = vOTUs,
      values_from = CPM,
      values_fill = 0
    )

  if (nrow(wide) < 4) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
        labs(title = paste(tp_title(tp), "(too few samples)"))
    )
  }

  mat <- wide %>%
    select(-Sample, -Diet) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rownames(mat) <- wide$Sample

  bc <- vegdist(
    mat,
    method = "bray"
  )

  ord <- ape::pcoa(bc)

  var <- ord$values$Relative_eig * 100
  pc1 <- round(var[1], 1)
  pc2 <- round(var[2], 1)

  coords <- tibble(
    Sample = rownames(ord$vectors),
    PCoA1  = -ord$vectors[,1],
    PCoA2  = ord$vectors[,2]
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      wide %>% select(Sample, Diet),
      by = "Sample"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Diet))

  ggplot(
    coords,
    aes(
      PCoA1,
      PCoA2,
      colour = Diet
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 4.2,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes(group = Diet),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 1.0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = diet_colors,
      breaks = diet_levels,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Diet"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = tp_title(tp),
      x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", pc1, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", pc2, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = TITLE_SIZE, face = "bold"),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = AXIS_T_SIZE),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = AXIS_TXT),
      legend.title = element_text(size = LEG_T_SIZE, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = LEG_TXT)
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          size = 6,
          alpha = 1
        ),
        nrow = 4
      )
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# Build 2x2 panel + one legend
# -----------------------------

tps <- c(0.25, 1, 6, 12)

plots <- lapply(
  tps,
  function(tp) pcoa_by_tp(df_i, tp)
)

names(plots) <- as.character(tps)

panel <- (
  plots[["0.25"]] + plots[["1"]]
) / (
  plots[["6"]] + plots[["12"]]
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = LEG_T_SIZE,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = LEG_TXT
    )
  )

panel

# Save ----------------------------------------------------------------

outdir <- here(
  "results",
  "figures",
  "PCoA"
)

dir.create(
  outdir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    outdir,
    "PCoA_panel_Diet.pdf"
  ),
  panel,
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    outdir,
    "PCoA_panel_Diet.png"
  ),
  panel,
  width = 14,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# Figure 5F + SAME FOR Exclusive BF

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)
library(rlang)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint_label = case_when(
      timepoint_months == 0.25 & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Week Infant",
      timepoint_months == 1    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "1 Month Infant",
      timepoint_months == 6    & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "6 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months == 12   & mother_infant == "infant" ~ "12 Months Infant",
      timepoint_months %in% c(0.25, 1) & mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool" ~ "Mothers",
      bodysite == "breastmilk" ~ "Breastmilk",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    timepoint_label = factor(
      timepoint_label,
      levels = c("1 Week Infant","1 Month Infant","6 Months Infant","12 Months Infant","Mothers","Breastmilk")
    ),

    # (se mantiene por si lo necesitas luego, pero NO se usa en la etiqueta)
    Host.label = coalesce(Host.genus, "Unclassified") %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_extract("(?<=g__)[^;]+") %>%
      replace_na("Unclassified"),

    CPM = as.numeric(CPM),
    RPK = as.numeric(RPK)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(timepoint_label)) %>%
  # --- QUITAR Mothers y Breastmilk ---
  filter(!timepoint_label %in% c("Mothers", "Breastmilk")) %>%
  droplevels()

# Normaliza binarios a Yes/No con niveles fijos
normalize_yesno <- function(df, var){
  var <- enquo(var)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      !!var := case_when(
        is.na(!!var) ~ NA_character_,
        str_to_lower(as.character(!!var)) %in% c("yes","y","true","t","1","si","sí","s") ~ "Yes",
        str_to_lower(as.character(!!var)) %in% c("no","n","false","f","0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ as.character(!!var)
      ),
      !!var := factor(!!var, levels = c("Yes","No"))
    )
}

df <- df %>%
  normalize_yesno(Contact_BF) %>%
  normalize_yesno(Exclusive_BF)

yesno_colors <- c("Yes"="purple4","No"="gold")


# Top 30 global -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
load_or_build_top30 <- function(df_ready, top30_rds, ord_rds){
  if (file.exists(top30_rds) && file.exists(ord_rds)) {
    top30_tbl    <- readRDS(top30_rds)
    orden_labels <- readRDS(ord_rds)
  } else {
    df_presente <- df_ready %>% filter(CPM > 0)

    top30_tbl <- df_presente %>%
      group_by(vOTUs) %>%   # <- solo vOTUs
      summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(total_CPM)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 30) %>%
      mutate(label = vOTUs)  # <- etiqueta SOLO vOTUs

    orden_labels <- top30_tbl %>% arrange(total_CPM) %>% pull(label)

    saveRDS(top30_tbl, top30_rds)
    saveRDS(orden_labels, ord_rds)
  }
  list(
    top30_tbl = top30_tbl,
    top30_ids = top30_tbl$vOTUs,
    orden_por_CPM = orden_labels
  )
}

top30_obj <- load_or_build_top30(df, top30_rds, ord_rds)

faltan <- setdiff(top30_obj$top30_ids, unique(df$vOTUs))
if (length(faltan) > 0) {
  message("Faltan en este DF estos vOTUs del Top-30 de referencia: ", paste(faltan, collapse = ", "))
}

# Helpers for tables and plots (prevalence) ----------------------------------------------
build_prev_table <- function(df_ready, group_var, top30_obj){
  gv <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(group_var))

  denoms <- df_ready %>%
    distinct(subject, {{group_var}}, timepoint_label) %>%
    count({{group_var}}, timepoint_label, name = "n_subjects")

  prev_tbl <- df_ready %>%
    filter(vOTUs %in% top30_obj$top30_ids, CPM > 0) %>%
    distinct(subject, vOTUs, {{group_var}}, timepoint_label) %>%
    count(vOTUs, {{group_var}}, timepoint_label, name = "n_pos") %>%
    left_join(denoms, by = c(gv, "timepoint_label")) %>%
    mutate(prevalence = 100 * n_pos / n_subjects) %>%
    left_join(top30_obj$top30_tbl %>% select(vOTUs, label), by = "vOTUs") %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = top30_obj$orden_por_CPM))

  prev_tbl
}

plot_prev <- function(prev_tbl, group_var, legend_title, palette, breaks = NULL){
  gv <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(group_var))
  if (is.null(breaks)) breaks <- names(palette)

  ggplot(prev_tbl, aes(x = prevalence, y = label, fill = .data[[gv]])) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, name = legend_title,
                      breaks = breaks, drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))) +
    labs(title = paste0("Prevalence of the 30 most abundant vOTUs by ", legend_title),
         x = "Prevalence (% subjects)", y = "vOTU") +
    facet_wrap(~ timepoint_label, nrow = 1, scales = "fixed") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
    )
}

## Contact_BF --> Human milk exposure (Yes/No)
prev_contact <- build_prev_table(df, Contact_BF, top30_obj)
gg_prev_contact <- plot_prev(prev_contact, Contact_BF, "Contact BF", yesno_colors, breaks = c("Yes","No"))
print(gg_prev_contact)

## Exclusive_BF (Yes/No)
prev_excl <- build_prev_table(df, Exclusive_BF, top30_obj)
gg_prev_excl <- plot_prev(prev_excl, Exclusive_BF, "Exclusive BF", yesno_colors, breaks = c("Yes","No"))
print(gg_prev_excl)
```
